scope: pre-live validation of a special isolated test-network genesis

selected_parameter_change.all_other_probe_genesis_fields: native defaults generated by the pinned binary

validation.stdout: File at /root/.inference/config/genesis.json is a valid genesis file

native_reasoning.finding: The normal parameter validator accepts every uint64 value, including zero.
A zero epoch reward produces zero RewardCoins without removing an otherwise active participant.
Settlement writes EpochPerformanceSummary with claimed=false for each participant before skipping a zero payment.

test_meaning: The live test will keep the Host on the ordinary active-participant/positive-PoC path and suppress only the isolated network epoch subsidy. With no workload, unchanged native settlement must itself create the exact existing earned=0, rewarded=0, claimed=false summary consumed by Marketplace.
